record.question:
One reason governments continue to invest heavily in basic scientific research, even when immediate
    commercial applications are not apparent, is that:
options: Fundamental research often provides the knowledge base from which transformative technologies emerge in the future
Basic research always produces direct economic profits within a short period
Applied research becomes unnecessary once basic research is funded
Scientific knowledge has no relationship with technological innovation
